payload.title: Chatticus: Babulus tools and approval mapping
payload.description: Cross-repo dependency (AnthusAI/Chatticus). Chatticus has no product plug-in contract yet; MCP and connectors are documented, not built. When ready, add Babulus tools to bots, map publish/send-style actions to Chatticus's approval gate (pi/gate.ts), and decide whether factories act through Prospectus accounts. File on the Chatticus board when the service API exists.
